page.layout: One title page, centred, with the title lines printed in capitals and larger type; a small mark "COM." at the lower right. The scan is printed upside down, so the lines are read from the top of the printed page.
page.notes: The scan is upside down. The line "in loca quædam Selecta," is set in italic and is hard to read; "Selecta" is uncertain [?]. The mark "COM." at the lower right is probably a printer's or collation mark and is not a running head or signature. No engraving or stamp is visible.
